snippet.title: Well Dweller - Official New Demo Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take a fresh look at Well Dweller in this trailer for the upcoming dark fairy-tale Metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family. Well Dweller will be available on Nintendo Switch and PC. A new demo will be out on Steam on June 12, 2026.
